mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ur.tenant_application_id = r.tenant_application_id AND ur.application_id = r.application_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_application_id = #{instanceId} AND r.available = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY r.sort, r.id
